literal: Добавить read-only doctor для missing/corrupt blobs, dangling refs/work, duplicate application, stale generation, orphaned batch, missing receipt и archive coverage. Ремонт и повтор отправки не выполняются doctor автоматически.
acceptance: Root decision pending; this maps concrete current scopes and exclusions, not universal completion.

commands.request: uv run --offline --frozen python -m tools.request_doctor --database COPY.db --output out/request.json
commands.work: uv run --offline --frozen python -m tools.work_doctor --database COPY.db --output out/work.json
commands.computation: uv run --offline --frozen python -m tools.computation_doctor --database COPY.db --output out/computation.json
commands.source_archive: uv run --offline --frozen python -m tools.source_history_doctor --database COPY.db --output out/source.json --candidate-traces
commands.content: uv run --offline --frozen python -m tools.content_history_doctor --database COPY.db --output out/content.json
commands.new_batch_integrity: uv run --offline --frozen python -m tools.batch_integrity_doctor --database COPY.db --output out/batch-integrity.json

missing_corrupt_blobs.status: Current metadata parents/checksums covered; actual raw blob bytes deferred/not assessed.
missing_corrupt_blobs.boundary: Artifacts/complete-response receipts retain identities/size/status and known graph refs. Current profile does not promise durable raw body retention. No filesystem/object backend, missing-object scan or fetch is invented; deferred DA2 storage work is separate.

dangling_refs_work.status: Covered for the explicitly typed stored graph/work edges below; not arbitrary JSON reachability.
dangling_refs_work.boundary: Document owner/change and known publication links, revision-work snapshots/results/handoffs, review owner/context, known result/application/target/source/content parents are checked. Opaque targets and absent legacy context remain unknown; no universal inverse Bill-to-queue ownership assertion or reconstruction from current Bill/URL.

duplicate_application.status: J249 adds missing explicit duplicate census.
duplicate_application.boundary: Matches actual generation-key or complete target-key SQL identity, never answer/body similarity or duplicate billing. Existing model/current CHECK reject NULL-generation plus NULL-target; pre-v50 generation is NOT NULL. Damaged rows count invalid, not duplicates; no valid legacy target is invented.

stale_generation.status: J249 adds missing active primary generation advisory.
stale_generation.boundary: Only queued/submitting intents and unconsumed items for analysis/reanalysis with explicit saved integer generation and exact SQL owner are compared. Mismatch is warning: reset/late response can legitimately leave old work. No historical paid/application generation comparison. DocumentWork and AmendmentRevisionApplicationWork define no generation; their dependency checks stay with work_doctor.

orphaned_batch.status: Existing exact child-item-without-parent-batch check; not a standalone whole-batch cardinality census.
orphaned_batch.finding: missing_batch error for an llm_batch_items row whose LEFT JOIN llm_batches has no parent provider.
orphaned_batch.boundary: This is distinct from document/review orphan work. Existing commands do not inspect every batch row for absent/partial item sets versus request_count. No current/forgotten/historical batch cardinality rule is asserted without a qualified producer/retention contract.

missing_receipt.status: Known frozen request/input-parent checks plus request-SHA-group missing-item warning; not universal exact paid-receipt matching.
missing_receipt.finding: result_without_batch_receipt warning means known request SHA appears in saved result refs but no stored item in that same SHA group.
missing_receipt.boundary: Grouping is by SHA, not exact provider/batch_id/custom_id. Another same-SHA item is not proof of the original paid receipt. Legacy absent hashes/erased input remain unknown; historical missing receipts are not automatically corrupt or rebuilt. Exact paid-receipt lineage after retention is not claimed by this warning.

archive_coverage.status: Saved native metadata/coverage bounds and graph presence checked; complete raw archive traversal/body retention not claimed.
archive_coverage.boundary: Opt-in candidate-traces validates model/SQL counts, coverage bounds and known parents. Prefix/omitted or unsupported metadata cannot certify omitted raw tails, source completeness, legal selection or full archive traversal; no backend/raw source fetch is attempted.

remaining_unassessed_capabilities: Standalone batch-row versus expected item-cardinality/receipt completeness, with separately qualified active/forgotten/historical semantics.
Exact original paid provider/batch_id/custom_id receipt lineage when a same-SHA different item exists; SHA grouping alone does not prove it.
Actual durable raw blob existence/hash and full raw archive traversal outside the deferred metadata-only retention profile.
production_implementation_scope_frozen: J249 V2; this acceptance map does not expand it.
